hero.title: About 4S
hero.subtitle: 4S helps students make confident education choices with transparent data, AI guidance, and real student insights.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.desc1: Choosing a university should be clear, practical, and personalized. We built 4S to remove confusion from the decision process.
mission.desc2: By combining trusted tuition data, matching intelligence, and student experience signals, 4S gives each learner a clearer path forward.

data.title: Data Integrity
data.desc: We prioritize reliable and up-to-date information to help users compare options with confidence.

students.title: Student First
students.desc: Every product decision is made around student outcomes, accessibility, and long-term growth.

guidance.title: Actionable Guidance
guidance.desc: We turn complex information into practical recommendations that users can act on immediately.
